notes: v1.2.0: Song quality + vocal closeness. The vocal is now a doubled track with a formant peak shaped by your base pitch, a glide into each note, vibrato on long notes and breath on soft notes — and every melody note is kept inside your recorded range. Final chorus lifts a whole step with a fifth harmony. Mix has real dynamics (verses back, choruses hit), humanised drums (timing + velocity feel), fills into each new section, crash on section starts, and a walking bass (root to fifth). Any tap anywhere now warms audio up, so Play can't get stuck behind Android's tap rule.
